data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Evadne, meaning 'evan' (evanish) and 'dne' (grace). In Greek mythology, Evadnee was a nymph who married a mortal man and was given eternal life by the gods after his death. The name Evadnee carries the meaning “God's grace, kind” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Evadnee usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Ευαδνή
